result.summary: The page is mostly well-composed, but there are a few visual/consistency problems: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab, a restaurant name is truncated without ellipsis handling, and a category chip is awkwardly clipped at the screen edge.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar shows 'Profile' as the active (highlighted green) tab, but the screen displayed is clearly the Home feed. The 'Home' tab appears inactive/gray.
issues.suggestion: Correct the active-state logic so the tab corresponding to the currently displayed screen (Home) is highlighted.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word at the screen edge without a visible ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis within the card width, or ensure the card peeks in a way that makes horizontal scrolling obvious.

issues.description: The category chip row shows a partially clipped, empty-looking pill at the far right edge after 'Healthy', with no visible label, appearing as a stray UI fragment.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so a portion of the next chip's label is visible, signaling scrollability instead of looking like a rendering glitch.

issues.description: Delivery time badges ('15-25 min', '20-30 min') overlap the food images inconsistently — the third card's badge is partially cut off by the screen edge along with the card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure badges remain fully within their card bounds and that partially visible cards clip cleanly at consistent points.
